name: 36305 · Dothan, AL
findings: ZIP 36305 (Dothan) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36305 (Dothan) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
